scenes.heading: Handling multiple clients' urgent requests at the same time

sents.d: Handling multiple clients' urgent requests at the same time
Every client feeling like your top priority is a system problem, not a personality problem.

A simple triage habit — clarifying with each client what response time to actually expect (e.g. within 24 hours, not instantly) at onboarding — prevents the common trap of every request feeling equally urgent just because it arrived first.

Blocking dedicated time per client rather than constantly context-switching between all of them throughout the day tends to produce better work and less stress than trying to be reactive to everyone simultaneously.

When two genuinely urgent requests do collide, communicating proactively with both clients about timing (rather than silently prioritizing one) maintains trust even when someone has to wait a bit longer.

take: Agree response times, block client time and communicate early.
